title: Test Haayre Barre
intro: Renndo, karallaagal e mawnikinaare, ƴetti lefol mum en e nder koye mum en tigi. Kono nde maande laaɓnde neldaa e maɓɓe, jarribo goonɗinal e reentaade, mawnikinaare maɓɓe ardi e maɓɓe e laawol ngol ngartataa. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude ndee fedde e batte mum ?
clues: Min ngonnoo ko joom en kaaƴe, min njuɓɓinta koɗorɗe mawɗe to bannge koɗli.
Nelaaɗo e nder leñol men arii e men, ina noddi en yoo en ndew Alla gooto Goonga oo.
Min ɗaɓɓi maande ngam hollirde konngol makko, tagoore wootere yaltinaa ngam jarribaade min.
En ndokkaama yamiroore laaɓtunde : renndinde ɓuuɓri ndiyam men e ooɗoo tagoore, ɗaccude ɗum yara e ñalawma mum toɗɗaaɗo.
E nder mawnikinaare amen, seeɗa e amen mbaɗi feere, min ndartini jeertinaango ngoo, min mberli tagoore nde fotnoo wonde maande amen.
Min ndokkaama balɗe tati ko adii halkaare amen, ndeen ɓuuɓol mawngol nanngi min e nder galleeji amen, acci min ngalaa nguurndam, min njippii.

arabic: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers." (7:77)
